Name: HERO_STATUS_PARAM
Description: Determines the level break points from which the stat curves are calculated.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: 0 on the Ironeye, Raider, Revenant, Executor and three Libra rows; set on the rest.

Fields.Name: Hero Level
Fields.Description: Hero level this row gives the stats for. A hero's rows have consecutive IDs from its HeroParam Hero Status ID, in rising level order; at a level between two rows, every stat is interpolated linearly between them (fractions dropped). Retail: rows for levels 1, 2, 12 and 15; the stat-shift rows (300000+) for levels 1 and 12.

Fields.Name: Vigor
Fields.Description: Vigor at this hero level (interpolated between rows). Retail stat-shift rows (300000+) hold signed stat changes.

Fields.Name: Mind
Fields.Description: Mind at this hero level (interpolated between rows).

Fields.Name: Endurance
Fields.Description: Endurance at this hero level (interpolated between rows).

Fields.Name: Strength
Fields.Description: Strength at this hero level (interpolated between rows).

Fields.Name: Dexterity
Fields.Description: Dexterity at this hero level (interpolated between rows).

Fields.Name: Intelligence
Fields.Description: Intelligence at this hero level (interpolated between rows).

Fields.Name: Faith
Fields.Description: Faith at this hero level (interpolated between rows).

Fields.Name: Arcane
Fields.Description: Arcane at this hero level (interpolated between rows).

Fields.Name: Equipment Reinforce Level
Fields.Description: Value passed, at this hero level, to the setup of the hero's CharaInitParam equipment as its reinforcement level. Retail: hero level - 1 (0-14).

Fields.Name: Revenant Summon Level
Fields.Description: Added to the summon's BuddyParam Base Level SpEffect ID to pick the level SpEffect applied to Revenant's summoned family. Retail: hero level - 1 (0-14), so 290000 "Spirit Stat Change - Level 1" at hero level 1.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction
Fields.Description: Attack multiplier at this hero level for attacks with Use Hero Level Attack Rate set; mixed with Attack Correction (Sub) by the attack's Hero Attack Rate Mix (multiplier = (mix x this + (100 - mix) x sub) / 100). Retail: 1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction (Sub)
Fields.Description: Second attack multiplier at this hero level. Attacks with Use Hero Level Attack Rate on mix it with Attack Correction by their Hero Attack Rate Mix. Retail: 1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Executor Beast Level
Fields.Description: Added to PlayerCommonParam Beast Form SpEffect Base ID to pick the SpEffect applied to Executor and the Beast when he transforms. Only the low byte is used. Retail: hero level - 1 (0-14).
